name: Head of Grimson
summary: At the Deep Elem Mine, Grimson the Pale's severed head proves the Forsaken have secured its riches. Dalar Dawnweaver receives the trophy at the Sepulcher, and the mine's minerals can supply Varimathras's military campaigns.

sections.title: Securing the Deep Elem Mine
sections.body: Forsaken scouts called Darkstalkers found a strategic threat brewing in the southeastern hills. Archmage Arugal's shadowy enchantments had corrupted workers in the Deep Elem Mine and driven its overseer, Grimson the Pale, mad. From the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sent champions to kill Grimson and bring back his severed head. The trophy confirms the mine is free of rogue magic, leaving its underground wealth for Varimathras's forces.

sections.title: A Trophy for the Dreadlord
sections.body: The head of Grimson marks the end of his rule over the Deep Elem Mine. With the overseer gone, the Forsaken can work its rich mineral veins and turn the ore into weapons and armor. Those supplies sustain their advance across Silverpine Forest and the neighboring reaches of Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Grimson the Pale was the overseer of the Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest's southeastern hills. Arugal's spreading shadow magic corrupted him and the other miners, until the Forsaken intervened.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want Grimson's head?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver wants Grimson's head as proof that the corrupted overseer has been eliminated. Varimathras wants the mine's mineral wealth for the Forsaken war effort, and Grimson's death breaks the corrupted miners' resistance in its tunnels.

faq.q: Where is the Deep Elem Mine located?
faq.answer: The Deep Elem Mine lies in the hills southeast of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. The Forsaken contest its minerals with remnants corrupted by Arugal's magic.

faq.q: What role does Varimathras play in this task?
faq.answer: Varimathras directs Forsaken expansion across Lordaeron from the Undercity. The mine's resources serve his strategic goals by providing raw materials for his war effort in Silverpine.

angles.text: As Forsaken, claiming the mine fulfills Undercity high command's plans and proves your resolve to reclaim Lordaeron's vital infrastructure from maddened remnants.
Deep Elem Mine is one of Silverpine's prime mineral claims. Its overseer is gone, leaving raw ore available for Horde supply lines.
